slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Working first, then simplify
slides.subtitle: A practical workflow for coding agents.

slides.title: Use a checkpoint
slides.body: Let the agent get a version running, then commit that working state before changing more.

slides.title: Do not stop there
slides.body: Working code is not the finish line. Read the code and ask what each unfamiliar part is doing.

slides.title: Agents overbuild
slides.body: They can create wrappers, scripts, and abstractions that work but are harder to maintain than needed.

slides.title: Simplify with intent
slides.body: Keep the parts with a clear reason. Remove or rewrite the parts you cannot explain.
